ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the Institutional Planned Development 456 symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 16-D in the area bounded by

       a line 66.66 feet south of and parallel to East 64th Street; the alley next east of and
       parallel to South Kenwood Avenue; a line 83.32 feet south of and parallel to East 64th
       Street; South Kenwood Avenue

to those of an RM-5 District, Residential Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.



Common Address: 6407 S. Kenwood Ave.




                                               ____________________________________

                                               Jeanette Taylor

                                               Alderwoman, 20th Ward
